title: PeopleSoft Studio's Event Mapping writer writes what the Configure Event Mapping page writes
statement: On a lab content reference, saves through DatabaseProvider.saveEventMappingConfiguration produce the page's rows, VERSIONs, tombstones, counter moves and tracking rows as captured in em03-em08: configure, edit, an unchanged save (nothing written) and remove.

observations.observation: The live end-to-end proof's configure, edit, unchanged and remove checks all passed against HRDMO.
